one_line: Chinese Buddhist monk-pilgrim journeying through the Ganges plain around 400 CE to collect scriptures and observe Indian monastic life.

appearance.age_look: Late 50s to early 60s, lean but sturdy build, slightly stooped from long travel.
appearance.face: Oval face with high cheekbones, warm light-olive East Asian complexion, fine wrinkles at eyes and mouth, straight nose, calm thoughtful eyes, default expression a serene, observant half-smile.
appearance.hair: Completely shaved monk’s head with a very faint dark stubble, no facial hair, wearing a simple soft brown cloth cap fitted close to the skull when outdoors.
appearance.costume: Early 5th-century Buddhist pilgrim robes: inner long-sleeved tunic of undyed off-white cotton reaching the shins, wrapped by a main kāṣāya-style outer robe in muted saffron-ochre layered with a dull brick-red border, draped over the left shoulder and under the right arm in Indian fashion; a practical darker brown sash tied at the waist, simple soft leather travel shoes, and a plain cloth shoulder bag in faded tan hanging at his left hip.
appearance.signature: A weathered bamboo pilgrim staff about his height, banded with dark cord near the top and middle, with a small cloth bundle and a modest bronze begging bowl tied near the upper grip.

ref_desc: Faxian is a lean, older Chinese monk with a shaved head, serene oval face, saffron-ochre and brick-red Indian-style robes over an off-white tunic, a brown sash and tan shoulder bag, holding a bamboo pilgrim staff with a bronze begging bowl attached.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character of Faxian as a historically grounded early 5th-century Buddhist pilgrim in the middle Ganges plain: a lean older Chinese monk with a shaved head and calm, observant eyes, wearing era-accurate kāṣāya robes in muted saffron-ochre with a brick-red border draped over an off-white long-sleeved cotton tunic that reaches his shins, a practical darker brown sash at his waist, simple soft leather travel shoes, and a plain tan cloth shoulder bag hanging at his left hip. His face is oval with high cheekbones, light-olive East Asian complexion and gentle wrinkles, showing a serene half-smile. He holds a weathered bamboo pilgrim staff about his height, banded with dark cord, with a small cloth bundle and a modest bronze begging bowl tied near the upper grip. Use a restrained palette of saffron ochre, brick red, off-white, brown and tan, and show him standing in a neutral pose suitable as a character model sheet, clearly displaying his head, shaved hair, robes, sash, bag and staff from head to toe.
